title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 3.33 (unsettled) at 02:00 UTC on 25 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 25 日 02:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 3.33（不穩定）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 3.33 (3P) at 02:00 UTC on 25 September. The 02:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 02:59; hour-start 3.33/3P, hour-end 3.67/4M). Last-180 maximum is 3.67 (first at 2026-09-25T02:18:00 UTC; label 4M). Published-window maximum is 3.67 (first at 2026-09-25T02:18:00 UTC; label 4M). Window start 2026-09-24T22:00:00 UTC (358 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0. The 03:00 UTC hour on 25 September is still incomplete (58 samples).

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of the most complete recent hour (02:00 UTC on 25 September). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off. Hour-start 02:00 UTC is 3.33/3P and the hour ends 3.67/4M at 02:59. The 03:00 UTC hour on 25 September is incomplete (58 samples through 03:57).
